dossier.summary: Ledgerlight does monthly bookkeeping for dental practices. Each practice gets one bookkeeper who only works with dentists. Plans start at 450 dollars a month.

data.headline: Ledgerlight keeps its best line on the pricing page
data.summary: The pricing page says it plainly: one bookkeeper who only works with dental practices. The homepage says none of that. A practice owner lands on a line about financial clarity and has to click twice to learn what they would get.

findings.cost: A dentist can't tell you only work with dental practices, which is the one reason to pick you over the general bookkeeper down the street.

findings.quote: We leverage cutting-edge technology and proven processes to keep your books accurate.
findings.cost: This could describe any firm. It doesn't say who does the books, how often, or what the owner gets each month.
A consultation sounds like a sales call. Owners who want a price and a name first will put it off until next quarter.

findings.quote: Custom plans available for multi-location groups. Contact us.
findings.cost: Groups with three or more offices are your biggest accounts, and this line makes them wait for a call to learn the price.
Fine on its own, but it's the third vague line on the page. By here the reader wants one concrete thing.

rewrites.after: Bookkeeping for dental practices, by a bookkeeper who only works with dentists.
rewrites.why: A practice owner knows in one line why you and not the firm down the street.

rewrites.before: We leverage cutting-edge technology and proven processes to keep your books accurate.
rewrites.after: One bookkeeper keeps your books and sends you a report every month.
rewrites.why: It names who does the work and what lands in the owner's inbox.
Owners want a number before a call, and your pricing page already has one.

next_steps: Put "only works with dental practices" next to the headline. It's your strongest line and it's on page two.
Show a price range for multi-location groups so your biggest buyers don't have to call to get one.
